faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Jr. Lab/Field Helper post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the offline application form is 16th September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well before this date to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required is Middle with Punjabi. Additionally, experience in rice handling and related field/lab work is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Jr. Lab/Field Helper position?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for this post is between 18 to 63 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Jr. Lab/Field Helper post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 10,737/- per month on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the PAU Jr. Lab/Field Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it, and send it along with required documents and application fee to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 50/- for all categories, which needs to be submitted via a bank draft.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Jr. Lab/Field Helper post?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the interview for the Jr. Lab/Field Helper post be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted on 23rd September 2026. The exact location will be mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: You need to submit attested copies of proof of qualification, experience, age, and other relevant certificates along with the application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: Both the official notification and the application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University, www.pau.edu.
